description: Rules for code quality and custom component usage in the coaching portal frontend.

rules.title: MarkdownRenderer must handle details/summary tags
rules.description: The MarkdownRenderer component must map `<details>` and `<summary>` elements to custom interactive collapsible components (e.g. CollapsibleDetails) or native HTML details elements rather than stripping them or rendering them as plain text.

detection.pattern: Verify that MarkdownRenderer handles details and summary HTML tags

examples.bad: const MarkdownRenderer = ({ content }) => { return <ReactMarkdown>{content}</ReactMarkdown> } // missing custom component mapping for details

rules.title: Quiz checkboxes must render as InteractiveQuiz
rules.description: Any list items matching checkbox format `* [ ]` or `* [x]` inside a Concept Check section should be intercepted and rendered using a custom interactive `InteractiveQuiz` component with dynamic state (selection, feedback, reward messages, retry) instead of rendering as standard browser list items.

detection.pattern: Verify that MarkdownRenderer intercept list items with [ ] or [x] for quizzes

examples.good:
li: ({ children, checked }) => { if (isInsideQuiz) { return {children}; } return
  • {children}
    • }
